#### 1. MYPN-related myopathy  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.717)

**Proposed mechanism:** MYPN (HGNC:23246) —DISRUPTS→ Sarcomere organization and maintenance (GO:0030049); Sarcomere organization and maintenance (GO:0030049) —LEADS_TO→ Cardiomyopathy (HP:0001638); Sarcomere organization and maintenance (GO:0030049) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal muscle weakness (HP:0003691). **How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in MYPN that lead to a gain-of-function mechanism in either disease would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Exome Variant Ensemble Diverse (ExAC) or gnomAD allele frequency > 0.01 for pathogenic variants.)_
